title: Major healing mead

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Major healing mead is a Mistlands-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Major healing.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Mead base: Major healing is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 4 Blood clot
• 5 Royal jelly
Six Major healing meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
Upon consumption, it restores 125 health over 10 seconds.
A 2-min cooldown is applied preventing consumption of another healing mead.
